mapper.sql: select id, user_id, title, layout, thumbnail, create_time, update_time, status, ver, is_delete from resume
mapper.insert: insert into resume (user_id, title, resume_json, layout, thumbnail, create_time, update_time, status, ver, is_delete) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{resumeJson}, #{layout}, #{thumbnail}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status}, #{ver}, #{isDelete})
mapper.update: update resume set title = #{title}, resume_json = #{resumeJson}, layout = #{layout}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and is_delete != id
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, resume_json, layout, thumbnail, create_time, update_time, status, ver, is_delete from resume where id = #{id} and is_delete != id
